recentItems.title: Beyond Society | Official Teaser | Netflix
recentItems.description:
The rescue was only the beginning, but what came after deserves to be told too.

‘Beyond Society’ is the new Netflix documentary series created by J.A. Bayona and Carlos Torres, bringing together, for the first time, the testimonies of those who survived and the families of those who never returned.

An intimate look at what happened after the rescue, the stories that were left untold, and the lives that moved forward, forever marked by that experience.

‘Beyond Society’ arrives on Netflix on December 18.
